## Checklist

- [ ] `composer test`, `composer psalm` and `composer cs:check` pass locally.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the behaviour I changed.
- [ ] For a new provider: the checklist in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#adding-a-provider) is done.
- [ ] I have read every changed line and can explain it.
- [ ] AI use: I didn't use AI tools for this change, **or** I used them and disclosed it above, following [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#ai-assisted-contributions).
